LSE 0.6.2: faster long-context DFlash2 on the gfx1151, no server hang when an idle session is evicted, and no kernel compiles in the middle of a decode.

- macOS: needs mac_linuxgpu build 267 or later; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.
- Linux: needs the amdgpu kernel driver with KFD and access to `/dev/kfd`; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.

## Changes

- DFlash2 at long context on the gfx1151, code task: 50.1 tok/s at 64K, 42.9 at 128K and 28.8 at 256K (0.6.1: 39.2, 36.7 and 26.0). Draft-tree verify passes share each key and value read between two tiles, one-row decode batches its key reads, and the width policy prices wide trees correctly at a longer context.
- Evicting an idle session to make room for a growing one no longer hangs the server.
- Attention kernels read the KV cache's size at run time, so a session growing past a new cache rung compiles nothing in the middle of a decode.
- Kernels that stream large weights are timed cold when variants are compared.
- A run without a working GPU backend, or with an op that has no device kernel, fails instead of falling back to the CPU unless the CPU backend was chosen.
